words.ar: الأطراف المعنية / كل اللي ليهم علاقة بالمشروع
words.def: people or groups who are affected by or interested in a project or decision.
words.book: I also make sure to communicate with my team and stakeholders so everyone is aware of the priorities and we're all working toward the same goals.
uses: I'll share the revised solar project timeline with all stakeholders by Thursday.
did we loop in all the stakeholders? finance too?
Key stakeholders include the client's IT manager, facilities and procurement.
dont: All the people that have relation with the project.

words.def: needing to be done quickly because a deadline or time limit matters.
words.book: I prioritize competing tasks by first identifying the most critical and time-sensitive ones.
uses: Please note this offer is time-sensitive and valid until 30 September.
time-sensitive: client needs the PO signed today ⚠️
Let's start with the time-sensitive items, like the data centre shutdown window.
dont: This thing is urgent in the time.

words.def: to decide to use time, money or people for a particular purpose.
words.book: I prioritize competing tasks by using the 80/20 rule: I focus on the 20% of tasks that will have the greatest impact, and then allocate the rest of my time to the less important tasks.
uses: We've allocated two engineers to the UPS installation next week.
how much budget did they allocate for spare parts?
We need to allocate more resources to preventive maintenance.
dont: We put two engineers for this project.
doo: We allocated two engineers to this project.

words.ar: يحسّن لأقصى درجة / يظبط عشان يطلع أحسن نتيجة
words.def: to make something work as well or efficiently as possible.
words.book: I worked with management to acquire the necessary tools and resources, and also developed a new workflow process to optimize the team's performance.
uses: We can optimize your energy costs by adding a solar system to the site.
trying to optimize the technicians' routes, too much driving 🚗
The new ticketing system will optimize how we handle service requests.
dont: We want to make the performance better to the maximum.

words.ar: صافي الربح / النتيجة النهائية على الفلوس
words.def: a company's final profit; also, the most important point.
words.book: This led to an increase in customer satisfaction and a positive impact on the company's bottom line.
uses: Reducing unpaid invoices will have a direct impact on our bottom line.
bottom line: we can't deliver before the 15th
Service contracts are small, but they add a lot to the bottom line.
dont: This will make the company gain more money in the end.
doo: This will improve our bottom line.

words.def: to get something important, often after effort (approval, a deal, funding).
words.book: I communicated effectively with management to secure the necessary resources.
uses: I'm pleased to confirm we've secured the maintenance contract for all 12 branches.
We need to secure budget approval before we order the batteries.

upgrade.plain: I watch the market with my eye.
pro: I keep an eye on the market.
I put my eye on the market.
I watch the market by my eyes.

upgrade.plain: I decided based on the numbers.
pro: I decided from the numbers only.
I made the decision by the numbers way.

upgrade.plain: I made a meeting every day to check everyone.
upgrade.ar: عملت اجتماع كل يوم أتابع الكل
pro: I made a meeting daily for checking.
I implemented a daily check-in meeting.
I did every day meeting to control them.

upgrade.plain: I do first the urgent and important thing.
pro: I analyze the urgency and importance of each task.
I do first the most urgent.
I make the important before the other.

upgrade.plain: In the future I want to be a manager.
pro: In future I want to be manager.
I want to become a boss later.
My long-term goal is to advance to a leadership position.
upgrade.why: ‎long-term goal‎ و‎advance to‎ أحسن في المقابلات.
